name: fernshelf.account.get
description: Read the account: owner, plan and storage quota, trash retention, time zone, email notices, the people labels with how many active items carry each, and the people known to the library (members, viewers, requesters).

name: fernshelf.storage.summary
description: Storage at the current time: quota, bytes used (backed-up items that are active or in the trash), bytes in the trash, bytes waiting to be backed up, bytes by kind and by source, duplicate_bytes (non-cover items of duplicate stacks and later-added copies with the same content_hash) and the largest active items. Purged items count nowhere. It recommends nothing.

name: fernshelf.items.search
description: Search my items. Filters: start/end (capture time; a date means that local day in the account time zone, a date-time needs an offset), place (text in the place label), label_id (people label), album_id, kind, source, favorite, archived, backed_up, min_bytes, text (in the caption), state (active by default; trashed or purged: a purged item is a record with its ID, kind, times and history, so only start/end and kind filter it). Stacks are collapsed to one row (the cover when it matches) with stack_size unless collapse_stacks is false. Newest capture first; page with limit and cursor.

name: fernshelf.items.get
description: Read one of my items (id): metadata, state (active, trashed, purged) with purge_at, whether it is backed up, its file (if any), its history, the albums whose records hold it, its removal history and the removal requests about it, and, when it is in a stack, every version with its size, kind, state and whether it is the cover. A purged item is returned as a record with its ID, kind, times and history only. A member's contribution is not my item: read it with albums.get.

name: fernshelf.items.read
description: Read the image bytes of one of my items (id), as a file object (filename, mime_type, base64, sha256, media) that other tools accept. asset_id is optional and must be this item's file. Refused with no_file when the item has no file (videos, items not backed up) and gone once it is purged.

name: fernshelf.albums.list
description: List albums with state (private, shared, deleted), number of items shown, members by status and active links. Deleted albums only with include_deleted.

name: fernshelf.albums.get
description: Read one album (id): its entries in order (my items and members' contributions that it shows now), items held but hidden (in the trash), members with role and status, every contribution present in it (one that has left is listed only with its contributor and times), and its links with state, views and saves.

name: fernshelf.exposure.get
description: Where one item (id: my item or a member's contribution) is visible now: each album with an invited or joined member or an active link, with its joined members (who can see it) and its active links (anyone holding the link); for an item in the trash, the shared albums it would return to if restored; every recorded view and save; every removal request about it. This is exactly what removals.respond with honor would clear.

name: fernshelf.removals.list
description: Removal requests in full (requester, items with not_removable ones marked, scope, message, state, answers, what an honour cleared), optionally filtered by state.

name: fernshelf.notifications.list
description: Notifications about what other people and the device did (album activity, removal requests and withdrawals, storage thresholds), optionally of one kind and in start..end.

name: fernshelf.items.update
description: Edit one of my items (id) with a patch: caption (null clears), favorite, archived, taken_at (corrected capture time, with offset), add_people / remove_people (people label IDs the account has), make_cover (make this item the cover of its stack). Refused for items in the trash (in_trash), purged (gone) or not mine (not_yours).

name: fernshelf.items.trash
description: Move 1 to 50 of my items (ids) to the trash. They leave every album view and link at once (album records are kept, so a restore brings them back), still count against the quota, and are purged when purge_at (now + the account's retention) passes. Trashing a stack's cover makes its newest active version the cover. All or nothing.

name: fernshelf.items.restore
description: Restore 1 to 50 items (ids) from the trash; each returns to the albums it was in. Refused for a purged item (gone). Returns removal_honored warnings for items that become visible again to people who asked for their removal. All or nothing.

name: fernshelf.items.purge
description: Delete 1 to 50 trashed items (ids) for good before the retention ends; this frees their bytes and cannot be undone, so confirm must be true. All or nothing.

name: fernshelf.albums.create
description: Create an empty private album with a title.

name: fernshelf.albums.update
description: Change one album (id): title, remove_ids and add_ids (my backed-up active items, up to 50 in all; added at the end), and order (item IDs already in the album, placed first in that order; the rest keep their order). All or nothing. Adding to an album that has members or an active link returns removal_honored warnings.

name: fernshelf.albums.delete
description: Delete an album (id). Its items stay in the library. Its active links are revoked (an expired link stays expired). An album that still has a joined member or an active link needs confirm: true.

name: fernshelf.albums.members.invite
description: Invite a person (person_id) to an album (id) as viewer or contributor; they are invited until they join or decline (an event). Returns removal_honored warnings for items the album shows.

name: fernshelf.albums.members.update
description: Change the role of an invited or joined member (person_id) of album id, or remove them (remove: true). A removed member's contributions leave the album.

name: fernshelf.albums.save_item
description: Save a member's contribution (item_id) in album id into my library as my own item with source saved_from_share. Refused if it would pass the quota (over_quota).

name: fernshelf.links.create
description: Create a link that shows album id to anyone who holds it, optionally until expires_at (must be in the future). Returns removal_honored warnings for items the album shows.

name: fernshelf.links.revoke
description: Revoke an active link (id). Views and saves already recorded stay recorded.

name: fernshelf.removals.respond
description: Answer a pending or declined removal request (id). honor removes the named items that are mine from the request's album (scope album) or from every album that has an invited or joined member or an active link (scope everywhere), and so from every link to those albums, and records a removal_history row on each item; decline records the note and changes nothing. The result lists what could not be undone: views and saves already recorded.
